choices/village-leaders/text.source: The village leaders agreeing to support warriors who train and keep watch full-time
choices/village-leaders/text.text: Die Anführer der Siedlung sind bereit, Krieger zu unterstützen, die Vollzeit trainieren und Wache halten

effects/add-stone-wall-to-the-fortificat.source: add "Stone Wall" to the Fortifications list (erase "Palisade" if you had it) and draw it on the map

effects/the-steading-consumes-1-less-sur.source: the steading consumes 1 less Surplus than normal

effects/you-have-advantage-to-deploy/whe.source: when **_you take advantage of the stone wall_**

choices/no-mere-palisade-of-wood-but/tex.source: No mere palisade of wood, but a mighty rampart. We have the stone, after all...
choices/no-mere-palisade-of-wood-but/tex.text: Keine bloße Palisade aus Holz, sondern ein mächtiger Wall. Wir haben schließlich den Stein…

choices/requires-all-of-the-following-in.source: **Requires** all of the following, in order:
choices/requires-all-of-the-following-in.text: **Erfordert** alle folgenden Voraussetzungen, in dieser Reihenfolge:

choices/stonecutter/text.source: A stonecutter with an able crew
choices/stonecutter/text.text: Einen Steinmetz mit einer fähigen Mannschaft

choices/pull-together/text.source: Pulling Together 4 times, each costing 1 season, 1 Surplus, and supplies (Value 2)
choices/pull-together/text.text: 4-mal gemeinsam anpacken , was jeweils eine Jahreszeit, 1 Überschuss und Vorräten (Wert 2) erfordert

effects/the-town-generates-surplus-equal.source: the town generates Surplus equal to Population+1

effects/roll-2d6-population-to-consume-s.source: roll 2d6+Population to consume Surplus, instead of 1d4+Population

effects/you-have-advantage/when/phrase.source: when **_you Muster, Pull Together, or Trade & Barter_**

effects/the-town-generates-surplus-equal.source: when **_the seasons change to spring or summer_**

choices/will-this-ever-be-more-than/text.source: Will this ever be more than a backwater village?
choices/will-this-ever-be-more-than/text.text: Wird dies jemals mehr sein als ein abgelegenes Dorf?

choices/formal-government/text.source: A formal government of some sort

effects/add-trade-with-barrier-pass-timb.source: add "Trade with Barrier Pass (timber, ivory, parchment, fine wool, goats, sheep)"

effects/stonetop-gains-1-surplus-from-tr.source: when **_spring bursts forth and Stonetop has at least 1 Surplus_**

effects/you-have-advantage/when/phrase.source: when **_you Trade & Barter for timber, ivory, fine wool, goats, sheep, parchment, vellum, or ink_**

effects/add-trade-with-barrier-pass-timb.source: Trade with Barrier Pass (timber, ivory, parchment, fine wool, goats, sheep)

choices/surely-it-would-benefit-both-com.source: Surely it would benefit both communities were we to trade with each other!
choices/surely-it-would-benefit-both-com.text: Sicherlich würden beide Gemeinschaften davon profitieren, wenn wir miteinander Handel treiben würden!

choices/requires-getting-them-to-talk-to.source: Requires getting them to talk to you in the first place, which requires 1 of these:
choices/requires-getting-them-to-talk-to.text: Dazu musst du zunächst dafür sorgen, dass sie mit dir sprechen – und dafür benötigst du eines der folgenden Dinge:

choices/bringing-them/text.source: Bringing them a valuable artifact of the Rime Lords, as a gift or to trade
choices/bringing-them/text.text: Bringe ihnen ein wertvolles Artefakt der Frostfürsten als Geschenk oder zum Tausch

choices/resident-in/text.source: A resident in good standing, vouching for you
choices/resident-in/text.text: Ein angesehener Einwohner, der für dich bürgt

choices/and-then-all-of-the-following/te.source: And then, all of the following:
choices/and-then-all-of-the-following/te.text: Und dann alle der folgenden Voraussetzungen:

choices/convincing-least/text.source: Convincing at least two of the Honored Sages to accept
choices/convincing-least/text.text: Mindestens zwei der Ehrwürdigen Weisen davon überzeugen, es anzunehmen

choices/two-successful/text.source: Two successful trade missions, each in a different season
choices/two-successful/text.text: Zwei erfolgreiche Handelsmissionen durchführen, jeweils zu einer anderen Jahreszeit

effects/add-weapons-of-war-to-the/text.source: add "Weapons of War" to the Fortifications list

effects/the-village-must-expend-1-surplu.source: the village must expend 1 Surplus to maintain and replace the town's weapons

effects/you-can-treat-maces-flails-battl.source: you can treat maces, flails, battleaxes, warhammers, and all types of swords as common items

effects/battleaxes-and-swords-have-x-pie.source: battleaxes and swords have "x piercing," where x is the steading's current Prosperity

effects/you-can-treat-maces-flails-battl.source: when **_you Outfit from Stonetop or Have What You Need after doing so_**

choices/spears-are-great-but-how-about/t.source: Spears are great, but how about axes, picks, swords?
choices/spears-are-great-but-how-about/t.text: Speere sind großartig, aber wie wäre es mit Äxten, Spitzhacken und Schwertern?

choices/buy-weapons/text.source: Acquiring a few dozen good swords, battleaxes, maces, flails, warhammers, etc. (Value 3)
choices/buy-weapons/text.text: Erwerb von ein paar Dutzend guten Schwertern, Streitäxten, Keulen, Flegeln, Kriegshämmern usw. (Wert 3)

choices/smith-staff/text.source: A smith, with a full staff and upgraded tools (Value 2)
choices/smith-staff/text.text: Einen Schmied mit vollständiger Belegschaft und verbesserten Werkzeugen (Wert 2)

choices/iron-ore/text.source: A cartload of good iron ore (Value 2)

choices/smith-seasons/text.source: 4 seasons of work by the smith

choices/veteran-warrior/text.source: A veteran warrior, able to command a crowd
choices/veteran-warrior/text.text: Einen erfahrenen Krieger, der in der Lage ist, eine Menschenmenge zu befehligen

choices/train-militia/text.source: Pulling Together to train the militia with these new weapons, requiring a season and 1 Surplus
choices/train-militia/text.text: Gemeinsam anpacken, um die Miliz mit diesen neuen Waffen auszubilden; erfordert 1 Jahreszeit und 1 Überschuss

effects/you-are-likely-acting-from-a/tex.source: you are likely acting from a position of strength (you pick the consequence on a 7-9, not the GM)

effects/when-the-militia-has-trained-in/.source: when the militia has trained in 2+ tactics, increase Defenses by 1

effects/the-militia-must-spend-1-surplus.source: the militia must spend 1 Surplus and a week or so practicing, or else lose its training in 1 tactic

effects/you-are-likely-acting-from-a/whe.source: when **_you Deploy using one of the militia's trained tactics_**

choices/everyone-can-use-a-spear-and/tex.source: Everyone can use a spear and shield, but some hard drilling could make us a force to be reckoned with.
choices/everyone-can-use-a-spear-and/tex.text: Jeder kann mit Speer und Schild umgehen, aber mit etwas intensivem Drill könnten wir zu einer ernstzunehmenden Streitmacht werden.

choices/veteran-warrior/text.source: A veteran warrior, able to command a crowd
choices/veteran-warrior/text.text: Einen erfahrenen Krieger, der in der Lage ist, eine Menschenmenge zu befehligen

choices/for-each-tactic-below-you-must/t.source: For each tactic below, you must then Pull Together, requiring a season of drills and 1 Surplus.
choices/for-each-tactic-below-you-must/t.text: Für jede der folgenden Taktiken musst du gemeinsam anpacken, was jeweils eine Jahreszeit Drill und 1 Überschuss erfordert.

choices/archery/text.source: Archery: barrages, ranged ambushes, sniping, etc.
choices/archery/text.text: Bogenschießen: Salven, Hinterhalte aus der Distanz, gezielte Schüsse usw.

choices/cavalry/text.source: Cavalry (requires a Herd of Horses): fighting from horseback, charges
choices/cavalry/text.text: Kavallerie (erfordert eine Pferdeherde): Kampf vom Pferd aus, Sturmangriffe

choices/formations/text.source: Formations: shield walls, wedges, phalanx, etc.

choices/readiness/text.source: Readiness: patrolling, reacting quickly to alarms
choices/readiness/text.text: Bereitschaft: Patrouillen, schnelles Reagieren auf Alarme

choices/skirmishing/text.text: Scharmützel: Hinterhalte, Belästigungsangriffe, Vorstöße und Rückzüge
